posts.title: How to Buy a Tesla in the Philippines (Without Even Test Driving One)

He flipped up his visor, looked at my Model Y, and asked the question I've been getting a lot lately: "Boss, how did you buy this car?" posts.title: CrackGate: Why I Cancelled My iPhone Duo Order and Switched to the iPhone 18 Pro Max
posts.description: I was going to buy the iPhone Duo. I had the order page bookmarked. My credit card was ready.
